name: listing.priceType
title: Field: listing.priceType
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.priceType field.
text:
# listing.priceType

TL;DR:
- listing.priceType tells the agent how to interpret listing.price.

What it means:
- closed: the listing exposes a fixed or already-determined price amount.
- open: the listing price should be treated as open for further interpretation rather than final.

Agent hint:
- Always interpret listing.price together with listing.priceType.
